statement: Warren 2026-10-08, listing snapshot storage (N-0101 finops FAIL: ~0.95 GB/day): store a raw page snapshot only when the extracted fields changed versus the listing's previous observation, or the fetch/parse failed; raw snapshots older than 90 days are cleared (the snapshot payload only; observation rows and extracted fields are kept forever). Applies to all retailers and to N-0085 units.
